bio.text: Joey Cohen-Saban is the Democratic and Fight Anti-Semitism Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 45 in Brooklyn in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.

He was also the Democratic candidate for the district in 2024; Ballotpedia lists the certified result as 15,383 votes (50.2%) for Republican incumbent Michael Novakhov and 15,151 (49.4%) for Cohen-Saban.
